scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm calling to check on the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it a little while ago and haven't heard anything back yet.
dialogue.agent: I can help you with that. What is the loan ID for your application?

dialogue.user: I don't have a loan ID number handy, but I do know I applied for a VA loan for a refinance. The loan amount was for $1,065,000 and it's for a term of 360 months.
dialogue.agent: Thank you for providing that information. I've located your application. The action taken on your VA loan for refinancing, in the amount of $1,065,000 for a term of 360 months, is that the loan was originated.

dialogue.user: Originated? That's great news! So, does that mean it's approved? And can you tell me what my interest rate is, and what the total costs of the loan will be?
dialogue.agent: Yes, an originated status means your loan has been approved and finalized. Your interest rate is 5.99%, and the total loan costs are $10,587.26.

dialogue.user: That sounds pretty good. Can you tell me if there are any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on my loan? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features. Your loan was sold to Ginnie Mae.

dialogue.user:
Okay, so the loan is finalized and sold. That's a lot of information to take in. I think I have everything I need for now.

<Satisfied> I'm satisfied with the interaction because you were able to clearly explain the status of my loan, my interest rate, and the associated costs. You also answered my follow-up questions about HOEPA flags and loan transfer.
